relation: definitional equality: U11 vdel_card, same_deck, reconstructible, same_edge_deck and edge_reconstructible are the public Reconstruction.foundations.decks definitions (the same bodies; the edge card is A4 canonical del_edge_set G [set e], of which U11 sdel_edge G e is a transparent alias), so every frozen = live certificate is a kernel conversion; the bijection-of-index-sets (multiplicity) model and every statement guard and the Whitney conditional premise are unchanged; the deepest Originals of the edge row and the two Whitney rows are A4 and A25 raw frozen rows, certified by their own certificates.
summary: deletion-decks (D1), one family: the undirected vertex- and edge-deletion decks of U11 (vdel_card, same_deck, reconstructible, same_edge_deck, edge_reconstructible) become public in the new module Reconstruction.foundations.decks with the same bodies; U11 keeps its five names as transparent aliases (decks required without Import), its statements, doc blocks and guards unchanged.
Baseline: accepted coordinator 3bdfdae (tree ade432af), which contains A4 (5ec0f33) and A25 with the C19 composition (ff7bd3b).

Rows: reconstruction_statement (opg; three-vertex guards on G and H, kept although redundant), edge_reconstruction_statement (opg; four-edge guard on G only), Kelly whitney_line_inversion_premise and implications_U11 external_whitney_line_inversion_statement (non-corpus; four-edge guard and same-edge-deck hypothesis; explicit conditional premises, unproved).

Deepest Originals: the vertex row is its own (chain unchanged since 3b2638f, upstream closure only); the edge row is A4 U11Legacy (raw edge deck at 9e03072) and the two Whitney rows are A25 KellyOriginal / ImplicationsU11Original (A4 raw edge deck and A25 raw line graph at 9e03072), certified through A4/A25 own certificates; the A4 and A25 certificate files are unchanged and compile.

Distinct, unchanged: Digraph P9 same_deck (directed switching deck, deferred separate family), U11 Seidel switching deck, X21 ell-decks; kelly's public boundary was extracted by the separate D2 change (theories/migration/kelly_public_boundary.v): kelly imports no conjecture module and binds the canonical decks, del_edge_set and simple_line_graph, every name, Arguments and type (by kernel ascription) kept. Proof-only adaptation: two rewrite lines of implications_U11.same_deck_equiv_x21_same_l_deck now use decks.vdel_cardE (the same equation as its vdel_card_setC1, for the canonical name); no statement or type changes.
